title: Resistance 2
subtitle: The invasion crosses the Atlantic

body: Resistance 2 is Insomniac Games' PlayStation 3 first-person shooter, released in North America on 4 November 2008. Nathan Hale returns to fight the Chimera as their invasion reaches the United States. Now part of the Sentinels, he serves alongside other soldiers infected with the same virus and dependent on inhibitors to restrain it. The campaign moves through recognisable American locations transformed by alien occupation. Its larger battles and enormous opponents expand the scale of the original game's alternate-history war, while Hale's condition continues to threaten him from within.

The campaign limits Hale to two carried weapons, asking the player to change equipment as the situation changes. Conventional-looking firearms share space with the series' stranger Chimeran designs, whose alternate functions can alter the way an encounter is approached. Health recovery and the available cover shape the pace of moving between attacks. Some enemies fill the landscape rather than behaving like another soldier in a corridor. These encounters emphasise the invasion's scale, turning a familiar street or skyline into the setting for a much larger threat.

Alongside the campaign, Resistance 2 introduced an eight-player cooperative mode built around complementary soldier classes and separate objectives. Competitive multiplayer supported much larger groups, making online play a major part of the release's identity. The division gave players several ways to return to the same war rather than simply replaying Hale's story. Critics praised its ambition and presentation, although changes from the first game divided players. Sony closed the online servers in April 2014. Resistance 3 continued the setting in 2011 with a more personal journey through its aftermath.
